One of the clearest warning signs for Republicans came from a Reuters/Ipsos survey released this week. results.content: Likely voters prefer Democratic candidates over Republican candidates by 16 points in the November congressional elections, their largest lead in any Economist / YouGov Poll this year so far. results.content: Latino voters have deeply soured on President Donald Trump and his party, particularly on crucial economic issues, a new NBC/Telemundo poll released Sunday finds. In the survey, Latino voters say by a 24-point margin, 59% to 35%, that they’d prefer to see the Democrats win control of Congress over the Republicans in November. That’s considerably broader than the 12-point Democratic margin among Latino voters at this point in 2024, although not as robust as the preference for Democratic victory ahead of the 2018 midterms.
